# IPTV Subscription UK 4K

> IPTV subscription for UK homes. 37,000 live channels, 198,000 on-demand films and series, native 4K UHD streaming and five simultaneous screens per account — from £5.85/month on the 24-month plan with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

IPTV Subscription UK 4K is a UK-focused IPTV subscription service. Every plan includes the full channel library, native 4K where broadcast, five simultaneous screens and a 30-day money-back guarantee. An optional Secure Proxy add-on and extra simultaneous connections are available at checkout as paid add-ons rather than bundled into the headline price.

## Consumer-rights context

Guides on this site describe UK consumer protection for distance-sold digital services as general information, not legal advice, and cite primary sources on legislation.gov.uk. The two instruments referenced throughout are the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 — source of the 14-day cooling-off period — and the Consumer Rights Act 2015, which governs whether a digital service is as described, fit for purpose and of satisfactory quality. The 30-day refund window offered here sits on top of that 14-day statutory minimum rather than replacing it.
